I_z=\iiint_\Omega(x^2+y^2)\rho(x,y,z)\,dv=\iiint_\Omega z(x^2+y^2)\,dv
$$
$$
=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^1r^3\,dr\int_{r^2}^{\sqrt{2-r^2}}z\,dz=\pi\int_0^1(2r^3-r^5-r^7)\,dr=\frac{5\pi}{24}.
